 About the match
 On this page you can find the Tampines vs Svay Rieng match lineup for AFC Champions League Two — Round 3 - First Leg, on Thursday 29-10-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Tampines lines up in a 5-4-1 led by Shahiran, while Svay Rieng sets up in a 4-1-4-1 led by Soeuy. Tampines is led by head coach Nazri Nasir, while Svay Rieng is managed by Matthew McConkey. The match is played at National Stadium Singapore.
